beIN SPORTS shines the spotlight on Thai Formula 2 driver, Tasanapol Inthraphuvasak in a new Off the Grid Origins special

23/09/2026 - 23:43

  • New half-hour original goes beyond the racetrack to tell the story of Tasanapol’s journey through Formula 2 and his ambition to reach Formula 1

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

beIN SPORTS is bringing fans closer to Thailand’s most exciting young motorsport talent, Tasanapol “Tas” Inthraphuvasak, in a new half-hour special charting his journey through Formula 2 and his ambition to reach the pinnacle of motorsport, Formula 1.

Advertisement

Presented in partnership with global travel connectivity brand Nomad eSIM, Off the Grid Origins: Tasanapol Inthraphuvasak goes beyond the racetrack to discover the story behind the young Thai driver, the people who have shaped his career and what it takes to compete at this level.

At just 20, Tas is already making his mark. Following a breakthrough 2025 Formula 3 campaign, where he claimed three victories and finished seventh in the Championship, he stepped up to Formula 2 with ART Grand Prix in 2026.

His first season in Formula 2 has been one of learning, resilience and breakthrough moments. After scoring points in both races in Melbourne, Tas had to navigate some challenging race weekends before finding his stride as the season progressed.

That breakthrough came at Spa-Francorchamps. Tas qualified on the front row, just 0.039 seconds from pole, before going on to lead the Feature Race and finish second. It was his first Formula 2 podium and the first for a Thai driver since Alex Albon in 2018.

But there is much more to Tas’ story than what fans see on the racetrack.

Off the Grid Origins takes fans behind the scenes to understand what has shaped him as a driver and what it takes to compete at this level. Tas opens up about his journey so far, the highs and lows of racing and the ambition that continues to drive him.

The special also brings together some of the people who know him best, including his parents, manager, mental coach and racing team, offering different perspectives on his talent and development, as well as the support and sacrifices that have helped him get to where he is today.

Away from racing, fans will also get to know another side of Tas, including how he balances life as a professional racing driver with studying mechanical engineering in the United Kingdom.

Magdalene Ng, Executive Vice President, Marketing, Growth & Consumer, beIN ASIA PACIFIC, said: “We have been following Tas’ journey for some time and it has been exciting to see his progress. His podium at Spa was a fantastic milestone, not only for him but also for Thai motorsport.

“With Off the Grid Origins, we wanted to go beyond the racing and give fans a chance to really get to know Tas, through his own eyes and the people who have been part of his journey. There is so much that goes into getting to this level, from the sacrifices and setbacks to the mindset and support behind the scenes. He has already achieved a lot at just 20, but what makes his story even more exciting is that there is still so much more to come.”

Shern Ng, General Manager at Nomad eSIM, said: “Tas’ journey has taken him from Thailand to Europe and the UK, and around the world, as he chases his dream of reaching Formula 1. Behind that ambition are the people he loves, the values that guide him and a determination to keep going further. That balance between ambition and what matters most is something we strongly identify with at Nomad eSIM. We’re proud to partner with beIN SPORTS to share his story and be there for fans of the sport, wherever they are.”

Off the Grid Origins: Tasanapol Inthraphuvasak premieres 25 September at 10pm (BKT) on beIN SPORTS, and beIN SPORTS CONNECT.
